nom: numbuzin No.9 NAD+ Collagen Under Eye Patch

avis.titre: What are these things supposed to even do?
avis.texte: First off, they are impossible to get out of their packaging. Second, they are so insanely slippery you have to put them on laying down and then keep moving them back in place every second, I basically needed to hold them in place for a while until they dried a little bit. However, I had to keep moving them back a bunch.

I bought these on a whim as I love numbuzin no 9. It did not disappoint. My undereyes look hydrated and tighter. I also notice less undereye darkness. I leave them on for 40 minutes and when I take them off they still aren't completely dry like most eye patches.
Hard to get out of package, easily breakable and didn't see any improvement

I love the cooling effect of these. They say long lasting and they are!!! I put them on my boyfriend after i used them for about an hour or so! id love to be able to try more from the no.9 series. My undereye was hydrated and less creasy dry and crepey during my makeup application.
